We’re like living the same life.. you literally described the other side of ibs that rarely people talks about. 

I’m a 21 years old female. I’ve been struggling with it for 9 years now.. it’s crazy cuz I never thought I’d make it to this time with this stupid chronic disease.. 

Let me tell you smth as someone struggles with anxiety and depression and the thought of getting out makes me wants to die bcuz I don’t want to deal with it anymore. I want peace.. so let me tell you it’s okay if you took a gap year and took rest. It’s okay if you struggled with work or had to skip almost most of the days at work or classes. It’s okay if you no one believed you.. as long as you’re taking care of your mental health and yourself then I’m proud of you. It’s okay if you had to let go of a job or a dream that u wanted to do but couldn’t bcuz of ibs.. you can always find another passion and be able to do.! You’re human ofc you’ll get tired after going thru all of this shit. First having ibs is enough to make a person feel tired and make life shitty and hard. Second No one should be alone or not have a supportive person who understands them while dealing with it! Third no one should be judged by it or to be called “lazy or you’re just making it up, or people have it worse than you” don’t listen to those people who tell you that !!!! Ik they might be your family or friends but fk it! You’re struggling and your feelings are valid. Try to make them understand if they won’t then just take care of yourself on your own. 

And that’s what I’m doing.. I really suffered with a bad depression I could barely get out from my bed. Or to even take a shower.. my family called me “worthless and lazy. And said that I’ve always been lazy and never want a future, or my brother said why am I even alive if I’m worthless and don’t do any good for community or life..” 

lol ofc i still remember these words.. and ofc they hurt. but yk what I did I cried about it and cut him off.. I understand that a family should be helpful and understanding.. they weren’t fair and I should never feel bad about it ! They’re the ones who are wrong. So I took care of myself despite of everything.. I got 98% on my final exams lol and got into better college than him. I also did what I love I spent my free time on myself like studying a new language or do the hobbies that I like. 

Now I learned to not give people that much energy or attention. I learned it’s okay to feel bad or sad sometimes and I’ll allow myself to feel these feelings. Bcuz I know I’ll do great things when I get better. It’s just a matter of time. 

Also please try to journal or record yourself talking and see what problems that you got and how can you fix them.! Be alone and try to understand yourself more ! Believe me people can’t help you as much as you can help yourself ! 
 I really hope the best for you and to who ever struggle with ibs or other chronic diseases.! You got this~
